comment: Gate G-R2 on the rented machine (md/N2.md, section 3.5; md/PLAN.md, entry of 6 Oct 2026, 1:34 PM IST). n2_check: the dispersion routine of md/qm/n2_batch.py against the 38 values of gate G-R, and point X of gate G-R computed again by md/qm/n2_batch.py, which must give the energy of md/qm/gr/qm/X.json within 1e-7 Hartree (the proof that the new runner has the settings of the gate); about 2 minutes. n2_points: the single points of the new geometries in the order of md/qm/n2/split.json, the main list of 144 (task n2_points) and then, in a task added later, the reserve of 48, four at a time with 4 threads each (16 CPUs), one JSON per point in md/qm/n2/qm/; no new point is started after 6:30 PM IST; restartable (finished points are skipped, a stopped SCF goes on from its orbitals). BOTH TASKS NEED 16 CPUs: they start only when qm_hess (16 CPUs) is not running. To give them the machine: queue.py cancel qm_hess (its finished displaced gradients stay in /root/cqc-sfa-md/qm/prod/hess_disp and are read again, md/qm/run_qm.py lines 348 to 352; the gradient in progress is lost); afterwards: queue.py retry qm_hess. Without that they wait for qm_hess to end by itself. To stop the batch at the next SCF cycle and let the runner start it again: touch /root/cqc-sfa-md/qm/n2/STOP. To end it: queue.py cancel n2_points. Progress without any energy: /root/cqc-sfa-tools/env/bin/python md/qm/n2_batch.py status; tail /root/cqc-sfa-md/qm/n2/batch.log. ADDED 6 Oct 2026, 2:50 PM IST: n2_esp_Rx (the potential of the large model in the R-like placement, needed only if the declared second step of the plan is taken; about 15 minutes on 16 threads, after the main list) and n2_reserve (the reserve list; its own marker, because the success test of n2_points holds already when it starts). When n2_reserve has ended: queue.py retry qm_hess.
